company.name: Cardda
company.shortDescription: Cardda is a financial service provider that specializes in virtual credit card payments and prepaid services.
company.description: Cardda is a developer of a virtual card that allows people to take control of all their payments. The company's technology recognizes all charges made to the cards and organizes them by area or employee, allowing businesses and startups to contract online services that require a credit card using prepaid virtual cards.

productsAndServices.description: Instantly issued digital cards for business payments, allowing control over spending and easy organization by department or employee.

productsAndServices.description: An API-driven solution for automating bulk bank transfers with real-time payment status and secure processing.
